To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the disturbance observer (DOB)-based torque control implemented in Valkyrie's actuators is able to achieve improved impedance rendering fidelity by leveraging the disturbance observer, as opposed to increasing the gains of an outer impedance compensating controller.

(1) the DOB based torque controller implemented in the Valkyrie robot improves the ability of the actuator to render desired impedance dynamics; (2) the improvements in the actuator's impedance rendering fidelity are significant; (3) the improvements are achieved by leveraging DOBs rather than by increasing compensator gains; and (4) the improvements are realized with a minimal impact on the actuator's torque control performance.
